data.title: 长离 · 今州城观景阁红白华服羽衣主控跨坐
data.description: 离火赤焰的绝对掌控。长离将华贵的红白羽衣长袍解开，跨坐在你的腰间。粉色极长秀发在炽热的气流中轻舞，那双含笑带挑衅的凤眸如秋水般动人，饱满雪白的大白兔在羽衣掩映下剧烈晃动。双手按在棋盘上，主动沉腰研磨，离火真气从肌肤缝隙中丝丝升腾——「棋差一着……便要任人宰割……不知漂泊者大人，打算如何惩罚输棋的老师呢？」
data.action: 棋盘旁跨坐视角腿上红白羽衣大敞露巨乳，粉色长发飘拂，凤眸含春戏谑主动沉腰
data.lighting: 离火余烬提供暖色主光，水阁外池面映出微弱反光
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet Jinzhou waterside pavilion at night, Changli straddles her partner's lap beside a low wooden Go board, resting both palms along its rim with a languid, teasing smile. Her feather-trimmed white robe and high-slit crimson cheongsam slip open to bare her breasts above sheer black thighhighs, lit by warm drifting embers and faint pond reflections.
data.nsfwProse: Her feather-trimmed red-and-white robe and high-slit crimson cheongsam slip wide off her shoulders to bare her breasts above sheer black thighhighs as she sinks onto her partner's lap.
data.animaCaption: Straddling the viewer's lap beside a low Go board in the waterside pavilion, she rests both hands on the wooden board edge as her feathered red-and-white robe falls open to bare her chest. Warm floating embers glow over her teasing smile and reflect off the dark pond outside.
